title: Suspend an OTA from the tenant page
caption: The status change is the effect (storefront and OTA API answer TENANT_SUSPENDED within 60 s); the OTA worker only does housekeeping. Resume is the same path with tenant.resume. Code: (app)/tenants/[tenantId]/actions.ts suspendTenant.

steps.label: Suspend OTA: Kind of suspension abuse|request|admin + Reason (5-500)
Zod: tenantId pattern, kind, reason trimmed
tenants active → suspended (suspended_at, suspension_reason); provisioning_jobs suspend; audit tenant.suspended; email_outbox tenant.suspended
after commit: vx:invalidate tenant; ota-tenant-ops tenant.suspend (<jobId>-<attempt>)
'The OTA is suspended.' + Suspension job link; page revalidated, only Resume offered
housekeeping: expire open checkouts, void authorisations, deny staff refresh
job succeeded ('Done' on /provisioning-jobs/<id>); e-mail '<name> has been suspended' sent
